Text: Introducing Bot Mode for Hermes Agent.

Bot Mode is an alternative to sessions mode, where you have one chat with each agent profile, or "bot". These bots can be given jobs, descriptions, profile pics, and communicate with your other bots!

For one day we will do a public beta test of Bot Mode for Hermes Desktop through this plugin:

https://t.co/FNYCm5pcjL

Give me all your feedback here on how it does for you, if it works as expected, any bugs. Then we'll address the feedback and get it into the main Desktop App for everyone!
